items.html: And there is a second surrounding light upon it, and it is also HaVaYaH in the filling of Yodin, like this: Yod-Hey-Yod, Vav-Yod-Vav, Hey-Yod, but vocalized in all its ten letters with the aforementioned vocalization: the three letters of the Yod have three Cholam points; and in the two letters of the Hey, a Tzere in each of them; and in the three letters of the Vav, three Kamatzim, beneath each of them a Kamatz point; and in the two letters of the Hey, a Tzere beneath each of them.
